── tracked requests (0 waiting of 0) ──
   no tracked request on the board. One is created by `agentbus request send`;
   an ordinary cmd directive is not one and cannot record acceptance.

── cmd threads with no answer in the retained history (0) ──
   untracked: the protocol records no acceptance for these, and an answer
   that has been trimmed from the stream looks the same as one that never came.
